title: Kenyan Chocolate Lava Cake
community: Urban Kenya — the fine dining showpiece dessert
author: Chef Amina Hassan
desc: Kenyan Chocolate Lava Cake — individual dark chocolate fondants baked until the exterior sets while the centre remains molten, served with passion fruit coulis and vanilla ice cream. The most theatrical restaurant dessert — and made with Kenya's excellent coffee-dark chocolate.
longDesc: Chocolate lava cake (fondant) is the restaurant dessert that produces the most pleasure per bite — the moment when the fork breaks the exterior and the warm chocolate flows out is pure theatre. Made with dark chocolate and a touch of Kenyan espresso, it is a dessert of extraordinary intensity.
ingredients: Passion fruit coulis (from 4 passion fruits blended with 1 tbsp honey)
steps: Butter and cocoa-dust the ramekins. Refrigerate.
Melt chocolate and butter together over a bain-marie. Stir until smooth. Cool slightly.
Beat eggs, yolks, and icing sugar until pale and ribbon-like — 4 minutes.
Fold chocolate into the egg mixture.
Divide into ramekins. Refrigerate until needed (up to 24 hours).
Bake from refrigerated for exactly 11—12 minutes — the edges should be set, the centre should wobble.
Rest 1 minute. Invert onto plates. Dust with cocoa.
Serve with passion fruit coulis and ice cream.
chefTips: Prepare and refrigerate the unbaked fondants up to 24 hours ahead — the make-ahead restaurant trick.
Timing is everything — 11 minutes from a cold ramekin, 9 from room temperature. Know your oven.
Test with a spare ramekin before service to confirm your oven timing.
cookingScience: The outer layer of the fondant reaches full protein coagulation (set) while the centre temperature does not reach this threshold in the 11-minute window, remaining liquid. The precise timing depends on ramekin size, oven accuracy, and batter temperature — a test run is always recommended before service.
sustainabilityTips: Use Kenyan-grown cocoa where available — the industry is growing.
storage: Unbaked fondants refrigerate 24 hours. Freeze for 2 weeks.
culturalNote: Chocolate lava cake at a Nairobi hotel is the dessert that makes diners feel they are in one of the world's great restaurants — and the passion fruit coulis makes it unmistakably Kenyan.
